rail.en: The train followed the rail along the edge of the valley.
rail.zh: 火車沿著山谷邊緣的鐵軌行駛。

railroad.en: The old railroad connected several small towns across the region.
railroad.zh: 這條老鐵路連接了該地區的幾個小鎮。

railway.en: A new railway station opened near the university last year.
railway.zh: 去年大學附近啟用了一座新的火車站。

rainbow.en: A bright rainbow appeared after the afternoon shower ended.
rainbow.zh: 午後陣雨結束後出現了一道明亮的彩虹。

raincoat.en: She packed a raincoat because the forecast predicted showers.
raincoat.zh: 因為預報可能下雨，她帶了一件雨衣。

rainfall.en: Heavy rainfall raised the river level during the weekend.
rainfall.zh: 週末的大量降雨使河流水位上升。

rainy.en: The class moved indoors because the morning was rainy.
rainy.zh: 因為早上下雨，班級把活動移到室內。

raisin.en: He found a raisin inside the oatmeal cookie.
raisin.zh: 他在燕麥餅乾裡發現一顆葡萄乾。

rally.en: The team began a late rally and nearly tied the game.
rally.zh: 球隊在比賽後段展開反攻，幾乎追平比分。

ranch.en: The documentary followed a family living on a cattle ranch.
ranch.zh: 紀錄片跟拍了一戶住在牧場的家庭。

rank.en: The survey asked students to rank their favorite study methods.
rank.zh: 調查請學生排列他們最喜歡的讀書方法。

rap.en: The music club performed a short rap during the school festival.
rap.zh: 音樂社在校慶時表演了一段短饒舌。

rash.en: The article warns against making a rash decision without enough information.
rash.zh: 文章提醒不要在資訊不足時草率做決定。

rat.en: A rat was spotted near the old storage building.
rat.zh: 有人在舊儲藏室附近看到一隻老鼠。

ratify.en: The council voted to ratify the agreement after a long debate.
ratify.zh: 經過長時間辯論後，議會投票批准了協議。

ratio.en: The teacher explained the ratio between distance and travel time.
ratio.zh: 老師解釋距離與旅行時間之間的比例。

rattle.en: Loose windows began to rattle when the wind became stronger.
rattle.zh: 風變強時，鬆動的窗戶開始喀喀作響。

raw.en: The graph displays the raw data before any calculations are applied.
raw.zh: 圖表呈現尚未進行計算前的原始資料。

ray.en: A ray of sunlight entered through the classroom window.
ray.zh: 一道陽光從教室窗戶照進來。

realism.en: The novel is known for its realism and detailed everyday scenes.
realism.zh: 這本小說以寫實風格和細緻的日常場景聞名。

realistic.en: The group set a realistic goal for finishing the project.
realistic.zh: 小組為完成專題設定了一個實際可行的目標。

reality.en: The experiment showed that reality differed from our first prediction.
reality.zh: 實驗顯示實際結果與我們最初的預測不同。

realization.en: She came to the realization that the schedule needed more time.
realization.zh: 她逐漸意識到這份時程需要更多時間。

realm.en: The discovery opened a new realm of scientific research.
realm.zh: 這項發現開啟了新的科學研究領域。

reap.en: Students who practice regularly often reap benefits during final exams.
reap.zh: 規律練習的學生常能在期末考獲得成果。

rear.en: The emergency exit is located at the rear of the hall.
rear.zh: 緊急出口位於大廳後方。

reassure.en: The teacher tried to reassure students before the difficult presentation.
reassure.zh: 老師在困難的發表前試著讓學生安心。

rebel.en: The history chapter describes why some citizens chose to rebel.
rebel.zh: 歷史章節描述部分人民為何選擇反抗。

rebellion.en: The museum exhibit explains the causes of the historical rebellion.
rebellion.zh: 博物館展覽說明那場歷史叛亂的成因。

recall.en: I can recall the main idea but not every detail.
recall.zh: 我記得主要概念，但不是每個細節。

receipt.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.
receipt.zh: 保留收據，以便需要退貨時使用。

receiver.en: The receiver checked the package before signing for delivery.
receiver.zh: 收件人在簽收前先檢查了包裹。

reception.en: The hotel reception desk remained open throughout the evening.
reception.zh: 飯店接待櫃台整個晚上都保持開放。

recession.en: The article explains how a recession can affect employment and spending.
recession.zh: 文章說明經濟衰退如何影響就業與消費。

recipe.en: The recipe uses simple ingredients that are easy to find.
recipe.zh: 這份食譜使用容易取得的簡單材料。

recipient.en: Each scholarship recipient received a letter from the school.
recipient.zh: 每位獎學金受獎者都收到學校寄來的一封信。

recite.en: Students were asked to recite a short poem from memory.
recite.zh: 學生被要求背誦一首短詩。

reckless.en: The story shows how reckless choices can create unnecessary problems.
reckless.zh: 故事呈現魯莽的選擇如何造成不必要的問題。

reckon.en: I reckon the project will take another week to complete.
reckon.zh: 我想這個專題大概還需要一週才能完成。

recovery.en: The town's recovery after the storm took several months.
recovery.zh: 這座城鎮在暴風雨後花了數月復原。

recreation.en: The park provides space for exercise and outdoor recreation.
recreation.zh: 這座公園提供運動和戶外休閒的空間。

recreational.en: The center offers recreational activities for students after class.
recreational.zh: 這個中心提供學生課後休閒活動。

recruit.en: The club hopes to recruit new members during orientation week.
recruit.zh: 社團希望在新生週招募新成員。

rectangle.en: Draw a rectangle around the important part of the diagram.
rectangle.zh: 在圖表的重要部分外畫一個長方形。

recycle.en: Our class collects paper so students can recycle it properly.
recycle.zh: 班上收集紙張，讓學生能妥善回收。

red.en: A red folder contains the forms for tomorrow's meeting.
red.zh: 紅色資料夾裡放著明天會議要用的表格。

reduction.en: The new lights produced a noticeable reduction in electricity use.
reduction.zh: 新燈具讓用電量明顯降低。

redundancy.en: The editor removed redundancy to make the paragraph more concise.
redundancy.zh: 編輯刪除重複內容，讓段落更精簡。

reef.en: The documentary showed colorful fish swimming around a coral reef.
reef.zh: 紀錄片拍到彩色魚群在珊瑚礁周圍游動。

referee.en: The referee stopped the match briefly to check the score.
referee.zh: 裁判短暫停止比賽以確認比分。
